English: Prayer Stone
A simple, weathered stone set upon the plains, marking a sacred space for prayer among the nomads.
Shrine Alcove
A small, roofed alcove built to shelter icons and relics, encouraging communal worship on the move.
Worship Hut
A makeshift tent of woven reeds and cloth, offering shelter for group prayers and spiritual gatherings.
Blessed Hall
A sturdy wooden hall, adorned with holy symbols, serving as the heart of spiritual life for the clan.
Saints Shelter
A mobile sanctuary honoring revered saints, its presence fostering unity and devotion within the horde.
Sanctuary Pavilion
A grand pavilion raised on wheels, lavishly decorated, serving as a spiritual anchor and refuge for the faithful.
Relic Room
A fortified chamber for the clans holiest relics, drawing pilgrims and strengthening the faith of the nomads.
Chapel House
A permanent, stone-built chapel for worship and counsel, a rare mark of settled faith among the nomads.
Pilgrims Hall
A magnificent hall welcoming pilgrims from across Iberia, its renown uniting the faithful clans and strengthening their bond.
Grand Iberian Chapel
An awe-inspiring, ornate chapel at the heart of the horde, drawing pilgrims and dignitaries from afar, and cementing the clans divine prestige.
